def main_process():
    n = int(input())
    v = list(map(int, input().split()))
    v.sort()
    left_idx = -1
    right_idx = 0
    max_distance = 0
    limit = int(input())
    while right_idx != n:
        left_idx += 1
        while right_idx < n and v[right_idx] - v[left_idx] <= limit:
            right_idx += 1
        max_distance = max(max_distance, right_idx - left_idx)
    print(max_distance)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main_process()
